title: TIMP1 and PKM drive immunosuppression and metabolic remodeling to promote colorectal cancer progression through integrated multi-omics analysis.
authors: Wang, Yukai; Zhang, Wei; Liu, Yongshuo; Tang, Xiaolong
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学分析探究结直肠癌免疫逃逸机制，虽涉及转录因子和AlphaFold3蛋白复合物预测，但核心是肿瘤免疫与代谢，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The majority of colorectal cancers (CRC) exhibit low tumor mutational burden and an "immune-cold" microenvironment, with immune evasion initiating as early as the precancerous stage. This characteristic significantly limits the clinical efficacy of immunotherapy. Therefore, this study aimed to identify key targets and mechanisms underlying immune evasion in CRC through integrated multi-omics analysis. Transcriptomic analysis identified 1341 differentially expressed immune evasion-related genes (IERGs), with 674 up-regulated and 647 down-regulated. Among these, 11 core transcription factors (TFs), including HDAC2 and E2F1, cooperatively drove the up-regulation of IERGs and were significantly associated with increased infiltration of immunosuppressive cells (MDSCs and M2-TAMs). Integrated analysis revealed tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases 1 (TIMP1) as a key effector molecule, whose high expression was associated with shortened overall survival and resistance to immunotherapy, and was involved in interferon signaling pathways. Single-cell RNA sequencing and T cell killing assay confirmed that TIMP1 significantly impaired the tumor-killing capacity and IFN-gamma secretion of CD8(+) T cells. Furthermore, post-translational modification (PTM) analysis identified pyruvate kinase muscle (PKM) as a cross-omics core regulatory node, with its mRNA and protein levels significantly up-regulated in CRC and correlated with poor prognosis. Five altered PTM sites on PKM (e.g., pS37) were also identified. AlphaFold3 structural prediction indicated a binding free energy of -8.4 kcal/mol for the PKM-lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA) complex, and Co-IP experiment further confirmed their physical interaction. Functionally, treatment with a PKM inhibitor significantly suppressed lactate production. This study reveals that TIMP1 promotes immunosuppression and PKM-LDHA drives metabolic reprogramming in CRC.
abstract_zh: 大多数结直肠癌（CRC）表现为低肿瘤突变负荷和“免疫冷”微环境，免疫逃逸早在癌前阶段即已启动。这一特征显著限制了免疫治疗的临床疗效。因此，本研究旨在通过整合多组学分析，识别CRC免疫逃逸的关键靶点及机制。转录组分析鉴定出1341个差异表达的免疫逃逸相关基因（IERGs），其中674个上调、647个下调。在这些基因中，包括HDAC2和E2F1在内的11个核心转录因子（TFs）协同驱动IERGs的上调，并与免疫抑制细胞（MDSCs和M2-TAMs）浸润增加显著相关。整合分析揭示组织金属蛋白酶抑制剂1（TIMP1）为关键效应分子，其高表达与总生存期缩短及免疫治疗耐药相关，并参与干扰素信号通路。单细胞RNA测序和T细胞杀伤实验证实，TIMP1显著损害CD8(+) T细胞的肿瘤杀伤能力及IFN-γ分泌。此外，翻译后修饰（PTM）分析鉴定出丙酮酸激酶肌肉型（PKM）为跨组学核心调控节点，其mRNA和蛋白水平在CRC中显著上调，并与不良预后相关。同时识别出PKM上五个改变的PTM位点（如pS37）。AlphaFold3结构预测显示，PKM-乳酸脱氢酶A（LDHA）复合物的结合自由能为-8.4 kcal/mol，Co-IP实验进一步证实了它们的物理相互作用。功能上，PKM抑制剂处理显著抑制乳酸产生。本研究揭示TIMP1促进免疫抑制，而PKM-LDHA驱动CRC中的代谢重编程。
